title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Issuing the Opinions on Promoting the Reform of the Criminal Procedure System Centered on Trial
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court  Supreme People's Procuratorate

Ministry of Public Security  Ministry of State Security  Ministry of Justice

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Promoting the Reform of the Criminal Procedure System Centered on Trial

Fa Fa [2016] No. 18

To the High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), State Security Departments (Bureaus), and Justice Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court and Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and the People's Procuratorate, Public Security Bureau, State Security Bureau, and Justice Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

On June 27, 2016, the 25th meeting of the Central Leading Group for Comprehensively Deepening Reforms considered and adopted the Opinions on Promoting the Reform of the Criminal Procedure System Centered on Trial. We hereby issue them for your earnest implementation in light of actual circumstances. New situations, new problems, and new experiences and practices discovered during implementation shall be promptly reported to the competent central authorities respectively.

July 20, 2016

Opinions on Promoting the Reform of the Criminal Procedure System Centered on Trial

In order to implement the relevant requirements of the Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Comprehensively Advancing the Rule of Law, and to promote the reform of the criminal procedure system centered on trial, these opinions are formulated in accordance with the Constitution and legal provisions and based on the actual work of the judiciary.

1. No person shall be found guilty without a lawful judgment by a people's court according to law. When handling criminal cases, the people's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs shall divide their responsibilities, cooperate with each other, and check each other to ensure accurate and timely ascertainment of criminal facts, correct application of law, punishment of criminals, and protection of innocent persons from criminal investigation.

2. Strictly in accordance with the requirements of evidentiary adjudication prescribed by law, no criminal facts may be determined without evidence. When an investigation organ concludes an investigation, a people's procuratorate initiates a public prosecution, and a people's court enters a guilty verdict, all must ensure that criminal facts are clear and evidence is reliable and sufficient.

Investigation organs and people's procuratorates shall collect, fix, examine, and use evidence in accordance with the requirements and standards of adjudication. People's courts shall determine evidence in accordance with statutory procedures and render judgments according to law.

Where a people's court enters a guilty verdict, for facts proving the constitutive elements of a crime, it shall exclude all reasonable doubt based on the entirety of the evidence in the case. Where there is doubt regarding sentencing evidence, a finding favorable to the defendant shall be made.

3. Establish and improve evidentiary collection guidance that meets the requirements of adjudication and suits the characteristics of various types of cases. Explore the establishment of a system of audio and video recording of processes such as inspection, search, identification, and pointing out in major cases such as homicide cases. Improve the rules for the transfer, review, court investigation, and use of technical investigation evidence, as well as procedures for out-of-court verification. Unify forensic examination standards and procedures. Improve the system for witnesses to the proceedings.

4. Investigation organs shall collect evidence related to the case comprehensively, objectively, and in a timely manner.

Investigation organs shall collect evidence according to law. Verbal evidence collected by illegal methods such as extortion of confessions by torture, violence, or threats shall be excluded according to law. Where physical evidence or documentary evidence collected by an investigation organ does not conform to statutory procedures and may seriously affect judicial fairness, and cannot be supplemented or reasonably explained, it shall be excluded according to law.

For physical evidence such as material evidence and documentary evidence, the original objects or original documents shall generally be obtained to ensure the authenticity of the evidence. Where examination is necessary, the items shall be promptly submitted for examination. Where there are contradictions among evidence, verification shall be conducted promptly. All evidence shall be properly preserved and transferred with the case file.

5. Improve the interrogation system to prevent extortion of confessions by torture and prohibit forcing anyone to incriminate themselves. Strictly in accordance with relevant regulations, interrogate criminal suspects in standardized interrogation venues. Strictly in accordance with legal provisions, conduct synchronous audio and video recording of the entire interrogation process, and gradually implement synchronous audio and video recording of the entire interrogation process for all cases.

Explore the establishment of a system for verifying the legality of interrogations before the conclusion of investigations in major cases. For major cases investigated by public security organs, state security organs, and people's procuratorates, procuratorial personnel stationed in the detention center shall question the criminal suspect to verify whether there has been extortion of confessions by torture or illegal evidence collection, and shall make synchronous audio and video recordings. If, upon verification, there are indeed circumstances of extortion of confessions by torture or illegal evidence collection, the investigation organ shall promptly exclude the illegal evidence and shall not use it as a basis for requesting approval of arrest or for referral for review and prosecution.

6. Before the conclusion of an investigation, if a criminal suspect pleads innocence or makes a lighter plea, or if a defense lawyer presents an opinion that the criminal suspect is innocent or should not be investigated for criminal responsibility according to law, the investigation organ shall verify the matter according to law.

7. Improve the system of supplementary investigation. Further clarify the conditions for returning a case for supplementary investigation, establish a mechanism for the people's procuratorate to provide guidance and reasoning when returning a case for supplementary investigation, and clarify the direction, standards, and requirements of supplementary investigation. Regulate supplementary investigation conduct. For matters that truly cannot be ascertained, the public security organ or state security organ shall provide a written explanation of reasons to the people's procuratorate. For cases that, after being returned twice for supplementary investigation, still lack sufficient evidence and do not meet the conditions for prosecution, a decision not to prosecute shall be made according to law.

8. Further improve the public prosecution mechanism. The burden of proof for the defendant's guilt shall be borne by the people's procuratorate. Where the defendant does not plead guilty, the people's procuratorate shall strengthen pre-trial preparation and in-court questioning, presentation of evidence, and cross-examination.

9. Improve the system of non-prosecution. For cases that do not meet the statutory standard of proof, the people's procuratorate shall make a decision not to prosecute according to law, preventing cases with unclear facts or insufficient evidence from entering trial proceedings. Improve the system of withdrawal of prosecution, and regulate the conditions and procedures for withdrawal of prosecution.

10. Improve procedures for pre-trial conferences. For cases tried under ordinary procedures, improve the pre-trial evidence disclosure system, and hear opinions on matters such as the list of witnesses to appear in court and the exclusion of illegal evidence.

11. Regulate court investigation procedures to ensure that litigation evidence is presented in court and case facts are ascertained in court. Evidence proving the defendant's guilt or innocence, or lighter or heavier guilt, shall all be presented in court, ensuring the right of the prosecution and defense to cross-examine according to law. For evidence concerning conviction and sentencing on which the prosecution and defense have disputes, cross-examination shall be conducted separately. For evidence on which the prosecution and defense have no objection at the pre-trial conference, the presentation and cross-examination may be simplified.

12. Improve the rules for court cross-examination of witnesses and expert witnesses. Implement the system for witnesses, expert witnesses, and investigators to testify in court, and increase the rate of testifying in court. If a public prosecutor, party, defender, or litigation representative objects to witness testimony, and the people's court considers that the witness testimony has a significant impact on the conviction and sentencing of the case, the witness shall testify in court.

Improve the witness protection working mechanism, and take protective measures according to law for persons who face dangers to personal safety due to testifying. Establish a mechanism for allocating special funds for subsidies to witnesses, expert witnesses, and others for testifying. Improve the system for compelling witnesses to appear in court.

13. Improve the rules for court debate to ensure that opinions of the prosecution and defense are presented in court. Court debate shall center separately on conviction and sentencing. For cases where the defendant pleads guilty, the debate shall mainly center on sentencing. The court shall fully hear the opinions of both the prosecution and defense, and ensure the right to debate and defense of the defendant and his defender according to law.

14. Improve the system of announcing judgments in court to ensure that the judgment result is formed in court. For cases tried under the fast-track sentencing procedure, judgments shall be announced in court in all cases except those with incidental civil actions. For cases tried under the summary procedure, judgments shall generally be announced in court. For cases tried under the ordinary procedure, the rate of announcing judgments in court shall be gradually increased. Regulate the system of scheduled judgments.

15. Adjudicate strictly according to law. After trial, if the people's court finds the facts of the case clear, the evidence reliable and sufficient, and determines the defendant guilty in accordance with law, it shall enter a guilty verdict. If it determines the defendant not guilty in accordance with law, it shall enter a not guilty verdict. If the evidence is insufficient and the defendant cannot be found guilty, the court shall, following the principle of leniency in cases of doubt, enter a not guilty verdict according to law.

16. Improve the supervision mechanism of the people's procuratorate over investigative activities and criminal trial activities. Establish and improve the supervision mechanism over compulsory measures. Strengthen the people's procuratorate's review of the necessity of detention after arrest, and regulate the application of non-custodial compulsory measures. Further regulate and strengthen the people's procuratorate's work of protesting against erroneous criminal judgments and rulings of the people's court, ensuring the timeliness, accuracy, and comprehensiveness of criminal protests.

17. Improve the system for safeguarding the rights of parties, defenders, and other participants in proceedings.

Guarantee according to law the rights of parties and other participants in proceedings to know, to make statements, to debate and defend, to apply, and to appeal. A criminal suspect or defendant has the right to obtain defense. The people's court, people's procuratorate, public security organ, and state security organ are obliged to ensure that the criminal suspect or defendant obtains defense.

Guarantee according to law the rights of defenders to meet with clients, review case files, collect evidence, question, cross-examine, and debate and defend, and improve the working mechanism facilitating defenders' participation in proceedings.

18. No defender or any other person may help a criminal suspect or defendant conceal, destroy, or forge evidence or collude in confessions, nor threaten or induce witnesses to give false testimony, nor engage in other acts that interfere with the litigation activities of judicial organs. Those who commit such acts shall be pursued for legal liability according to law.

19. Parties, participants in proceedings, and observers in the courtroom shall obey the direction of the presiding judge or the sole adjudicator during trial proceedings and comply with court discipline. Acts in violation of law such as disrupting court order or endangering court safety shall be dealt with according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be pursued according to law.

20. Establish a system of legal aid duty lawyers. Legal aid institutions shall station duty lawyers in detention centers and people's courts to provide legal assistance to criminal suspects and defendants.

Improve the legal aid system, and improve the working mechanism of legal aid upon application and the working mechanism of case-handling organs informing defenders. For case-handling personnel who fail to perform the duty of notifying or assigning a defender, accountability shall be strictly enforced.
